description.narrative: Detta program genomförs av UNDP och syftar till att ge tekniskt och logistiskt stöd till den konstituerande församlingens arbete både som författare av en ny konstitution och som parlament. Programmet innehåller också komponenter syftande till att stärka relationen mellan församlingen och befolkningen, samt till att erbjuda internationella erfarenheter.

This program, performed by UNDP aims to provide technical and logistical support to the Constituent Assembly both in its function as writer of the new Tunisian constitution, and as parliament. The program also contains components aimed at enhancing relations between the assembly and the general public, as well as providing information on international best practice and experience.
Support to citizen's especially the youth in democratic transition and strengthening the transparent political processes of political representation and inclusive dialogue respecting gender equality

Since the start of the project 2012 and until its end in December 2015, UNDP has managed to do a lot of what they set out to do in this project. There seem to have been an interest among the Tunisian MEPs and the parliament staff structures to make good use of UNDP to strengthen their capacity to assume their responsibilities. UNDP has worked closely with the parliament in the constitution drafting process, and have helped facilitate the National Dialogue for the new democratic constitution (that was adopted in early 2014 and hailed as a success). UNDP appears to have been successful in working with Civil Society Organisations to help spread information nationally about the new constitution. In Tunisia, a lot of attention has been on the parliament in the last years as Tunisia has been in a critical phase in its democratic development. The UNDP has been well placed to respond and has succeeded in contributing with needed and requested assistance.
